counting_rules.window: non-overlapping 1.2 s (60 steps) from the start of each recording; a final partial window is not counted
counting_rules.individuals: people or animals with at least one tokenised recording
counting_rules.channel_seconds: per group and kind: channels with a present value x 0.02 s
counting_rules.sites: laboratories per dataset (1 each); no two datasets are known to share a laboratory, so the total is the sum
counting_rules.tasks: distinct task labels per dataset, summed
counting_rules.totals: qualified datasets only; a dataset that is not qualified is listed with its reason
counting_rules.time_block_datasets: sabes and area2 (fewer than three individuals) count windows in folds 0-3 as inner training and in fold 4 (the latest block) as inner validation

quantity_diversity.D_arm_rule: A source is eligible for the D arms if it has at least W_max/8 unique inner-training windows. A source enters a k-source arm (k in {2, 4, 8}) only if it has at least W_max/k unique inner-training windows. For each k and each draw, the order of that draw in D-ARM-ORDERS.json is walked from the top: a source that is not eligible, or that has fewer than W_max/k windows (short for this k), is skipped, and the first k sources that remain form the arm. Each source of the arm gives W_max/k unique windows: the first W_max/k of its inner-training windows in the fixed hash order (the window order of ALLOCATION.json q_window_rule, applied to that source). A skipped source stays available to the arms with a larger k and to D_all. D_all takes floor(W_max / n) unique windows from each of the n eligible sources, in the same window order.

skipped_in_the_order.why: short for this k: fewer than W_max/2
short for this k: fewer than W_max/2
short for this k: fewer than W_max/4

D_all.note: floor(W_max / number of eligible sources) windows from each; the arm is short of W_max by the remainder

gait120.limit: the 3-person level has 105 windows, so each P arm of this dataset has 64 windows (W_max/4 would be 512); a limit of the arm, kept as the rule gives it

quantity_diversity.rule: W_max = smallest anchor inner-training window count rounded down to a power of 2; D-arm orders by ascending sha256('pooled-encoder-0.2|D|k' + k + '|draw' + draw + '|' + dataset) over the wave-1 sources and the admitted conditional sources; a source needs at least W_max/8 inner-training windows to be eligible and at least W_max/k to enter a k-source arm, and each arm takes the first k sources of its order that have W_max/k; D_all takes floor(W_max / n) windows from each of the n eligible sources; W_P = the largest power of 2 not above min(W_max/4, windows of the smallest P level)

padded_share.rule: each recording tiled into ceil(L/T) rows of T steps; share = padded positions / all positions

re_estimate.not_part_of_this_step: the 512-step GPU throughput and 16-thread CPU issuing measurements and the recomputed P3-P9 times are made before model choice, not in the data step
